source: Numbering follows the SAMA Cyber Security Framework (version 1.0, May 2017, as in force on rulebook.sama.gov.sa): domains 3.1 to 3.4, their 32 subdomains, and one control per numbered control consideration, so control 3.1.1.4 is consideration 4 of subdomain 3.1.1. Subdomain 3.3.12 is the exception: SAMA does not number its considerations, so its three items follow the subdomain's principle and the SARIE and Mada references it gives. Domain and subdomain names are SAMA's; control titles and all guidance wording are original to Offset Security. Read the framework itself at rulebook.sama.gov.sa.
